source_issue.title: user menu popup is not available on the site setup pages

summary_markdown:
## What this issue is about
This issue addresses a bug where the user menu icon is missing from the left sidebar on site setup pages. The problem stems from a condition in the code that controls the visibility of this menu.

## What needs to be done
The likely fix involves modifying a condition in the code to ensure that the user menu is always displayed, regardless of the page being visited. Specifically, it has been noted that the user icon is dependent on the `hideDefaultViewButtons` property.

## Helpful background
The missing menu is related to components in a file called `Toolbar.jsx`. Previous discussions have pointed to unresolved pull requests (PRs) attempting to fix this issue, so checking these PRs may provide insight. Note that there is some ongoing uncertainty whether the previous attempts have fully addressed the issue.

## Good first steps
1. Review the related PRs, especially #4565 and #8441, to understand current approaches.
2. Modify the code as suggested to ensure the user menu appears on all relevant pages.
3. Test your changes to confirm that the user menu works as intended.
4. Follow the [Plone contribution guide](https://6.docs.plone.org/contributing/index.html) for pull requests.
